meta.name: fluidsim
meta.description: Plan, configure, inspect, restart, and analyze bounded FluidSim computational-fluid-dynamics simulations with explicit numerical-validity and HPC safety checks. Use for FluidSim solver selection, parameter review, FFT/MPI setup, output diagnostics, or restart compatibility.

copy.tagline: 规划配置计算流体动力学仿真，进行数值有效性与HPC安全检查

copy.tagline_en: Plan, configure, and analyze FluidSim CFD simulations with validity and HPC safety checks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you conduct fluid dynamics simulations and need to ensure numerical validity and HPC safety

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能指导你使用 FluidSim 完成流体动力学模拟：帮你安装、选求解器、配置参数、检查数值有效性与 HPC 设置，并分析输出结果或重启模拟。
howto.when: 当你想做流体模拟（如 Navier-Stokes、浅水方程、分层流等），或需要选择求解器、配置参数、检查 FFT/MPI 设置时触发。

say.text: 帮我用FluidSim设置一个二维湍流模拟的参数
say.note: Claude会给出完整参数配置代码

say.text: 浅水方程应该用哪个求解器？

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can guide you through FluidSim fluid dynamics simulations: installing the package, choosing solvers, configuring parameters, checking numerical validity and HPC settings, analyzing outputs, or restarting simulations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to run fluid dynamics simulations (e.g., Navier-Stokes, shallow water, stratified flows), or need solver selection, parameter review, or FFT/MPI setup.

say_en.text: Help me set up a 2D turbulence simulation with FluidSim.
say_en.note: Claude will provide full parameter configuration code.

say_en.text: Which solver should I use for shallow water equations?
say_en.note: Claude will recommend sw1l and give an example.

say_en.text: How can I run FluidSim in parallel with MPI?
